    LargeIndecomposable.MeshWalk.exists_hasRayBasis_A0

    The ray basis of A₀ #

    Proposition 3.8 and Proposition 4.14 for A₀: the homogeneous normed multiplicative basis of A₀ (A0Normed.lean) is, after reindexing by the nonzero rays, a ray transversal killing zero ray products. This is the ray table P = ray A₀ with A₀ ≅ kP (exists_hasRayBasis_A0).
